response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), across_ratings AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS average_per_day FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.per_day) AS kept_average_per_day, AVG(p.per_day - a.average_per_day) AS average_excess FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN across_ratings AS a WHERE p.per_day > a.average_per_day

assumptions.assumption: Each rating’s per-day figure is the average of its films’ rental_rate divided by rental_duration.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute each rating’s per-day figure as its total rental rates divided by its total rental days, weighting films by duration.
